# engineering-influence

> An autonomous, evidence-bounded content-engineering pipeline. One controller layer is exposed as a REST API, an MCP server (tool: start_pipeline), a CLI (`ei`), a Python SDK and signed webhooks. Alpha (0.1.0a1); the runner and gate are deterministic placeholders. Public software only: author-owned books and profiles are not in this repository.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/adammatthewsteinberger/engineering-influence/blob/main/README.md): what it is, five-minute quickstart, limitations
- [Getting started](https://github.com/adammatthewsteinberger/engineering-influence/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): install, run the stack, first pipeline
- [Interfaces reference](https://github.com/adammatthewsteinberger/engineering-influence/blob/main/docs/INTERACTIONS.md): REST, SDK, MCP, CLI and webhook contracts, error codes, signature format
